sanskrit_verse: पदे प्रमूढे भग्ने वा विषमत्वाज जनान्तिके । यस्त्वासन्नतरो ग्रामो व्रजो वा तत्र पातयेत् ॥
transliteration: pade pramūḍhe bhagne vā viṣamatvāj janāntike | yas tv āsannataro grāmo vrajo vā tatra pātayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a path is misleading, broken, or dangerously uneven near populated areas, the authority nearest—whether a village elder or local leader—must ensure corrective action is taken.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is determined by proximity to the site of imbalance
Causation arises from neglect of structural integrity in shared spaces
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with immediate jurisdiction
Restoration logic requires correction of environmental misalignment
Consciousness alignment occurs through active rectification of disorder
executable_legal_axioms: IF path condition = misleading OR broken OR uneven AND location = near populated area THEN nearest governing unit MUST initiate restoration protocol
IF governing unit = within 5km radius THEN activation priority = HIGH
IF path hazard = unaddressed for >7 days THEN escalate to next-level authority
ACTION TYPE = realign spatial integrity NOT impose penalty
RESTORATION METRIC = path usability restored to dharma-aligned state
supreme_court_application: In cases involving infrastructural neglect leading to public risk, the Supreme Court shall assess whether the closest administrative unit was correctly identified and activated. Responsibility lies not in assigning blame, but in verifying alignment between capacity and corrective response.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that faulty infrastructure manifests due to absence of conscious oversight. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that neglect precedes disorder. Proportional responsibility rests with the nearest capable authority. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction without condemnation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Immediate assessment and repair of hazardous pathways
Reassignment of stewardship where prior authority failed
Community notification and engagement in restoration process
Completion certification by local Nyaya officer
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious restoration, not punitive reaction. The path is cleared, the authority responds, and reality aligns.
